research: The archival abstract records Caspar Schotte’s insult suit against Tönies Rosenberg, without occupation, relationship, or other identifying detail. The Brakel burgher family and other same-surname groups are possible comparisons, but neither a shared surname nor this brief case description establishes membership; attribution remains unresolved. Arcinsys identifies StadtA BW, W 1 as the Niederwildungen collection of Stadtarchiv Bad Wildungen; this establishes the archival collection’s locality, not necessarily the residence or family of either litigant: https://arcinsys.hessen.de/arcinsys/list.action?nodeid=g245266 The regional church archive catalogs Niederwildungen baptisms and marriages for 1651–1680 and a seventeenth- to eighteenth-century household register. The scans require access through Archion. The municipal archive also catalogs Ernst Waldschmidt’s genealogies of Niederwildungen families. No evidence from those collections has yet identified Tönies or established a Brakel connection. https://www.archion.de/en/alle-archive/hessen/landeskirchliches-archiv-der-evangelischen-kirche-von-kurhessen-waldeck/kirchenkreis-eder/bad-wildungen, https://arcinsys.hessen.de/arcinsys/showArchiveDetails.action?archiveId=109
